title: Eegduu Abidda Hin Dhaamne
intro: Fakkiin tokko dirqama uumamni biraa hin hawwine imaanaa itti kennamee, wanta hin mul’anne keessatti bakka baay’ee sodaatamu irra dhaabata. Lubbuuwwan rakkatan araara gaafachuuf yeroo iyyan, deebii cimaan golee ibiddaa keessaa ni dhaga’ama. Eenyummaa eegduu bara baraa kanaa saaxiluu dandeessaa?
clues: Seensa iddoo adabbii sodaachisaa bakka hin mul'anne keessa nan dhaabadha.
Ibiddi boba’aa fi hin dhaamne dirqama koo isa guddaa keessatti wiirtuu dha.
Lubbuun rakkatte, gidiraa isaanii isa dhuma hin qabne irraa boqonnaa kadhachaa maqaa koo waamtu.
Yeroo kadhatan, akka hin baane nan labsa, yoomiyyuu.
Ani nama miti, jinnis miti — ani uumama uumame kan ajajamuu qulqulluudha.
Ani ergamaa angafa eegduu bara baraa ibidda Si’ool ta’ee muudameedha.

arabic: وَنَادَوْا۟ يَـٰمَـٰلِكُ لِيَقْضِ عَلَيْنَا رَبُّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّكُم مَّـٰكِثُونَ
verse: And they will call, "O Mālik, let your Lord put an end to us!" He will say, "Indeed, you will remain." (43:77)
